description: This file defines a React context provider, hooks, and utility functions for managing the selected shop state across components and URL, with persistence via localStorage. It also manages a sidebar open state for mobile UI, integrating with Next.js navigation hooks.

classes.name: ShopContextValue
classes.description: Type for the contextual value, including selectedShopId, setSelectedShopId, sidebarOpen, and setSidebarOpen.

methods.name: buildUrlWithShop
methods.description: Constructs a URL with the given pathname and search parameters, updating the 'shop' query parameter based on provided id.

methods.name: safeGetLocalStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a value from localStorage safely, handling SSR environments.

methods.name: safeSetLocalStorage
methods.description: Sets or removes a value from localStorage safely, handling SSR environments.
